name: vwap_overshoot_fade_003
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, in moderate-VIX sessions (12-24), a 0.5% deviation from session VWAP is caused by structured retail stop-sweeps and short-horizon algo momentum triggers — not by institutional directional conviction (which would elevate VIX above 24) or by benign drift in dormant tapes (VIX below 12 where deviations are shallow and listless). When RSI(60) — a 5-minute exhaustion signal — reaches below 22 or above 78, the directional momentum engine has operated at maximum intensity for 5 full minutes without continuation: the triggering algos have exhausted their order queue. A green close bar (close > open) on the down-overshoot confirms that 5-second micro-momentum has already pivoted bullish before entry, rather than anticipating the turn — NIFTY's tight bid-ask and deep order book means a single pivot bar on the index reliably marks the order imbalance flip. VWAP-benchmarked institutional programs, delta-hedging market makers, and trapped short-term trend-followers then converge as reversion buyers, pushing the index back toward VWAP over the next 15-90 seconds.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: VWAP(typical_price=(H+L+C)/3, volume) cumulative from session open, resets daily
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no lookback needed, always cumulative. At 0.5% deviation (~112 pts at NIFTY 22500), VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos start accumulating as fills at this level give them significant benchmark outperformance. The 0.5% threshold is deliberately between v001 (0.3%) and v002 (0.6%): shallower deviations are filtered by the VIX regime check and the 5-minute RSI (both require sustained directional commitment), while deeper deviations (>0.6%) are rare and covered by v002. With VIX 12-24 acting as a quality gate, 0.5% deviations in this regime are reliably transient overshoots, not regime changes.

indicators.name: rsi_60
indicators.purpose: RSI(60) = 60 × 5s = 5 minutes — exact time-preservation of RSI(5) on 1-minute bars from the original (5 × 1-min = 5 min). This is NOT a 12x scaling; it maps the same 5-minute exhaustion window. The 5-minute RSI is the SLOWEST exhaustion read in the vwap_overshoot family — v001 uses 2-min RSI(24), v002 uses 3-min RSI(36). Requiring 5 minutes of sustained directional commitment before RSI hits extreme levels means the triggering momentum has been building long enough that it truly has no remaining order flow; the eventual reversion is more forced and more reliable.

conditions: vwap_dev < -0.005 (NIFTY >= 0.5% below session VWAP, ~112 pts at NIFTY 22500)
rsi_60 < 22.0 (5-minute RSI: multi-minute selling momentum fully exhausted)
close > open (current 5s bar is green: micro-momentum has already pivoted bullish)
vix_close in [12, 24] (moderate VIX regime: controlled overshoot, not news/panic-driven)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions simultaneously; candlestick confirmation replaces the index_return filter from the original by requiring the first reversal bar rather than a neutral index

conditions: vwap_dev > 0.005 (NIFTY >= 0.5% above session VWAP, ~112 pts at NIFTY 22500)
rsi_60 > 78.0 (5-minute RSI: multi-minute buying momentum fully exhausted)
close < open (current 5s bar is red: micro-momentum has already pivoted bearish)
vix_close in [12, 24] (moderate VIX regime: controlled rally, not institutional directional program)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points of further adverse extension from a 0.5% VWAP deviation entry. In moderate VIX (12-24) sessions, if NIFTY extends another 8 spot points after confirmed RSI(60) exhaustion and a reversal bar, the VIX regime filter failed to screen out a structural one-sided order — the thesis is wrong. NIFTY 15-90s moves at VIX 12-24 average 2-5 option pts; a 4pt adverse move clearly exceeds session-typical noise and marks thesis invalidation.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points ≈ 12 NIFTY spot points from entry. A 0.5% VWAP deviation (~112 pts) with VIX in moderate regime and confirmed exhaustion snaps back at minimum 10% of total deviation within 15-90 seconds. 12 spot points is ~11% reversion — conservative and reliably achievable as the first leg. At the 1-2 minute NIFTY horizon, typical option moves are 3-7 pts; 6 pts targets the median (1:1.5 R:R), appropriate given the extra entry confirmation requirement (candlestick + VIX) that sacrifices some entry frequency for higher quality.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST (45 min buffer before close, avoids afternoon gamma/liquidity risk)

filters.vix_filter: vix_close between 12 and 24 — PRIMARY differentiator from v001/v002, which both ignore VIX. Below 12: tapes are dormant, 0.5% NIFTY deviations rarely form or revert quickly. Above 24: momentum-driven or news-driven regime where RSI(60) exhaustion can be followed by continued directional extension rather than reversion.
filters.time_filter: 09:25-14:30 IST — significantly extended vs. other variants (09:20/09:25-11:15). VIX regime filter does the quality work throughout the session; moderate-VIX days generate valid VWAP setups in afternoon sessions when institutional programs are active, not just during the opening inventory correction window.
filters.volume_filter: implicit via RSI(60) — a genuine 5-minute overshoot requires sustained volume across 60 five-second bars; slow RSI naturally demands multi-bar participation at high intensity
filters.trend_filter: candlestick confirmation (close > open for CE, close < open for PE) acts as micro-trend reversal filter — requires the current 5s bar to have already flipped direction before entry, avoiding the still-accelerating portion of the move
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-medium — VIX regime filter makes this less session-structure-dependent than v001/v002 (which break on trend days), but trading opportunity disappears on high-VIX days which may be high-PnL sessions for other strategies

adaptation_notes: Four key changes from the original equity strategy: (1) RSI(5) on 1-min → RSI(60) on 5s: EXACT time preservation (5 min = 60 × 5s bars). The 5-minute RSI is the SLOWEST exhaustion read in the vwap_overshoot family — requires more commitment than v001's 2-min or v002's 3-min RSI, selecting for deeper and more persistent exhaustion states. (2) VIX filter (12-24) RETAINED and PROMOTED to core signal condition: the original's calendar filter becomes a real-time VIX reading from the 5s VIX feed. v001 and v002 both dropped the VIX filter; v003 keeps it as its primary regime selector — this is the central differentiation. (3) Candlestick confirmation ('close > open' for longs, 'close < open' for shorts) RETAINED directly from the original — translates naturally to 5s bars. This pivot confirmation distinguishes entering into a reversal vs. entering into a continuing overshoot. (4) Session extended to 14:30 IST: with VIX handling quality throughout the day, the early-session-only restriction of v001/v002 is unnecessary. ADX filter dropped because RSI(60) serving 5-minute exhaustion provides the same range-bound signal (sustained momentum builds ADX, but exhaustion after 5 min is a stronger filter). Bollinger bands dropped because VIX range already captures the 'inside intraday envelope' concept without the lookback noise of a 240-bar BB. Relative volume (rel_volume_20) dropped as index volume is incomparable bar-to-bar on a 5s feed.
weaknesses: On high-VIX days (>24) — often the most volatile and potentially profitable sessions — no trades fire, missing large directional moves that could be captured by other strategies
RSI(60) requires 5+ minutes of warmup bars to stabilize; early-session setups in the first 5 minutes after session start (09:25-09:30) have unreliable RSI readings
When VIX data is missing or stale, default of 15.0 falls inside the 12-24 regime, potentially allowing trades during actual high-VIX environments where the thesis breaks
Candlestick confirmation on 5s bars is fragile: a single pivot bar can be reversed in the next bar, meaning the 'reversal confirmation' can fail within 5 seconds

_source.original_stop: max(0.45% from entry, signal bar extreme)
